changes: Tap any painting to see it big. Pinch or double-tap to zoom in, and tap once to close.

test: Gallery → Packs → open an unlocked pack → "Play this pack": the game should fill the whole screen.
In a game with friends or the daily, tap the painting: it opens big, pinch to zoom, one tap closes it.
Swipe back while a painting is open: it should close the painting, not the game.
